content.title: Okta is providing extra security to AI agents, your data: CEO
content.description:
Shares of identity security company Okta (OKTA) are up by over 14% in 2025 as cybersecurity becomes an invaluable asset for AI products. Okta faces tough competition from Palo Alto Networks (PANW) and CrowdStrike (CRWD).

Okta CEO Todd McKinnon sits down with Opening Bid anchor Brian Sozzi to discuss the importance of integrating cybersecurity barriers and identity networks into AI, commenting on what the future of cyber attacks could look like.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
